2026_05_IND_PIT.headline: Indianapolis and Pittsburgh face a battle for manageable downs
2026_05_IND_PIT.paragraph1: Indianapolis visits Pittsburgh with both teams trying to establish control in a matchup where the Steelers’ defensive front can influence the passing game. The Colts need a credible rushing threat and clean protection to avoid repeated long-yardage situations. Pittsburgh, meanwhile, cannot rely solely on pressure; its offense must sustain possessions and prevent Indianapolis from dictating field position. The key interaction is whether the Colts can keep their playbook open on early downs or whether the Steelers can force hurried decisions and convert defensive stops into scoring opportunities.
2026_05_IND_PIT.model_rationale: Pittsburgh’s defense has a clearer path when Indianapolis faces predictable passing downs. The Colts can counter through balanced sequencing, while the Steelers’ own offensive consistency remains important.
